paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. Each group represents tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. Each color means that the same model is further fine-tuned on each specialty data.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability values for clinically relevant tokens between a baseline Mistral v0.2 model and a Mistral v0.2 model fine-tuned on various clinical specialties. The horizontal axis displays the names of the clinical specialties, ordered alphabetically from Cardio to Pediatrics, and represents the categories being compared. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” ranges from approximately -27 to -22 and uses a linear scale. The tick intervals are spaced by one unit, with values ranging from -27 to -22. There are nine bars, each corresponding to a different clinical specialty. The blue bar represents “Mistralv0.2-Base,” while the orange bars represent models fine-tuned on Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, respectively. The “Cardio” bar has a value of approximately -23.4, the “Gastro” bar has a value of approximately -23.6, and the “Pediatrics” bar has a value of approximately -23.2. All other bars represent values between -25.8 and -23.8.  None of the bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
